iconMap.description: Map of field value to icon suffix.

colorMap.description: Map of field value to color.

backgroundColorMap.description: Map of field value to background color.

text.description: Field based text configuration. First field value will be used for text.

randomizeBackgroundAndColor.description:
Picks a random color for background and text.
If true, it will select color and backgroundColor at random for the items without those settings.

image.description: Field based image configuration. Field value should have the absolute image url.

doubleDigitDelimiter.description: If set, and text has the delimiter, component shows doubleDigit initials. Default is singleDigit.
